body: On a side-note : I've been using `textureQueryLod` for a long time before this crash occurs.

Just one thought : according to the stacktrace, the error occurs are radeon driver level. So i've checked if the problem was outside Godot instead.

I've check `glxinfo` aswell, and the `GL_ARB_texture_query_lod` instruction is supported.

However, i've investigated the Godot code, and especially the `re-spirv` third-party library which excludes `OpImageQueryLod` from the supported operations at commit cf00643 (thirdparty/re-spirv/re-spirv.cpp , `SpvIsSupported` static function). This result in an interruption of the shader parsing (as `respv::Shader::parse` returns `false` - which is silently ignored - and thus, the call to constructor `respv::Shader` in [rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/dec5a373d97cbadce5e1fabe6095ae9957ff3aa6/drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp#L3927) silently fails, leading to a further failure when trying to push the half encoded shader into the pipeline.

Well, that's what I'm concluding after a quick glance.

Can you verify if https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/113708 at least makes it go through? Unsupported operations should just make the library skip optimization on it. I'll open a related issue to add support for this operation in the repository as well.
I added support for the related functions in this PR as well. https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/113708
